extracted.stage: First appointment listed in financial remedy proceedings
extracted.summary: A solicitor at Redfern Partners enquires about funding of around £16,000 for her client's costs in financial remedy proceedings at the Family Court in Cardiff, where matrimonial assets are around £795,000.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client, which we have received and logged. To take this further we would need confirmation of your client's identity and details, a costs estimate or schedule covering the work to be funded, information on the matrimonial assets and any existing charges over them, and confirmation of the proceedings and hearing listing. It would also help to have your firm's details and confirmation that you remain instructed. Nothing in this message constitutes an offer of funding or any indication of terms. A member of our team will review the information and come back to you.
